partnerTransactionId.description: Partner's unique transaction identifier. If the partner uses the MoneyGram transaction ID, pass the same value here. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{1,50}$ . Also serves as the idempotency key.

reasonCode.description: Reason code for the transaction status. Must be a valid 5-digit code from the published catalog.

partnerReasonMessage.description: Partner's free-text reason message or description, for audit and logging.
